note: The per-game effects on LP85 and FT09 are far beyond noise. The 25-game aggregate (8.0% vs 2.2%) is carried by 4 games, as the paper says. Furthest-level improvement on 18/25 games: sign test p = 0.043. best@k treats the 64-trial pool as the population, so its own sampling error (6/64) is ignored; at s = 0 the true single-agent rate could be up to about 4.6% (95% upper bound), and best@5 would then be about 21%, still far below 65%.
